$comment: All durable harness state, owned by the CLI (./AGENTS.sh) — never hand-edit. Keys: commands (via `cmd set/rm`; verify = definition-of-done step, init = session-start check), features (via `feature ...`; max one in_progress, never delete — mark done), progress (via `log`; append-only, display bounded by the CLI), rules (via `docs add/rm`; curated project knowledge), setup (present only while guided setup is pending). Future harness versions may add top-level keys. Transient scratch lives in agents.scratch.json (gitignored).

rules.text: AGENTS.sh = sole public entrypoint; finds python3/python >=3.8, execs .agents/agents.py (stdlib-only)
All durable state in .agents/agents.json behind the CLI; scratch (last verify) in .agents/agents.scratch.json, gitignored
One manual: AGENTS.md. CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md symlink to it; .github/copilot-instructions.md mirrors it; .claude/skills -> .agents/skills
CI (.github/workflows/agents.yml) runs ./AGENTS.sh ci: check, then init + verify once setup complete
Shell: POSIX sh, set -eu, portable. Python: stdlib-only 3.8+, no import-time side effects
Project commands are data (./AGENTS.sh cmd set), never edits to agents.py
Commits: one change each, imperative subject <=72 chars, prefixes feat:/fix:/docs:/chore:
CLI output ends with an actionable next: hint where possible
Done = ./AGENTS.sh verify green (registered --verify commands, cheap/fast first)
Template gates: sh -n AGENTS.sh, py_compile agents.py, ./AGENTS.sh check. Projects register real lint/test/build at setup
